notes: New look: anime-style shading (crisp light/shadow edge, colourful violet shadows, rim light on characters), deeper skies, lighter haze
Genshin-style camera: closer, chest height, follows behind you while running, no longer clips through houses
Characters: trainer proportions (bigger heads), warmer skin, glossier hair
Every town now has a Relay Center, Warden towns have a Trial Hall; benches and flowerbeds along the streets
Softer, denser grass and toon trees instead of autumn/dead trees in the green areas
